subject: Owner's Project Manager Request for Services
overview: The subcommittee finalized the draft Request for Services (RFS) for an Owner’s Project Manager and established a procurement timeline for the high school construction project. Members voted to recommend expanding the subcommittee to five members and to refer the amended RFS to the full High School Building Committee for approval.

items.title: Overview of MSBA Module 2 Requirements
items.summary: Chair Jenny Graham outlined the requirements for MSBA Module 2, which requires hiring an Owner's Project Manager (OPM) before selecting a project designer.

items.title: Draft Request for Services Walkthrough
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed a draft Request for Services (RFS) that details community background, project goals, and the potential for a 'Construction Manager at Risk' delivery method.

items.title: Building Specifications and Enrollment Data
items.summary: Discussion focused on incorporating enrollment projections, Chapter 74 vocational programming, and site-specific egress challenges into the RFS.

items.title: Evaluation Criteria and Scoring Matrix
items.summary: Members established a 270-point evaluation matrix to score bidders on personnel experience, technical capacity, and past performance.

items.title: Price and Value Assessment
items.summary: The group debated how to weight cost against technical value during the final selection phase to ensure high-quality design outcomes.

items.title: Interview and Selection Guidelines
items.summary: The committee set guidelines for shortlisting at least three firms and conducting final interviews not to exceed two hours in length.

items.title: Procurement Timeline and Advertising
items.summary: Procurement Administrator Fiona Maxwell advised shifting the proposed advertisement timeline to accommodate mandatory lead times for the Central Register and local newspapers.

items.title: Confidentiality and Open Meeting Law
items.summary: The committee discussed the application of Open Meeting Law to the bid review process and how to protect the confidentiality of competitive proposals during deliberations.

items.title: Subcommittee Expansion Recommendation
items.summary: Approved a motion to recommend increasing the subcommittee's size from three to five voting members to include broader perspectives during the OPM selection.

items.title: Referral of RFS to Full Committee
items.summary: Approved a motion to present the amended RFS to the full High School Building Committee for final input and approval.
